intro: July 7 is the first post-holiday session and the full portfolio BUY activation date. The NFP Goldilocks print (~119K) on July 2 — combined with the July 1 dual gate confirmation (SPX 7,483 >7,460; VIX 16.45 <17) — formally upgrades the market verdict from HOLD to BUY for Q3 2026. July 7 requires navigating four simultaneous frameworks: (1) NVDA full-size add: conditional on NVDA >$200 + SPX >7,460 + VIX <17 at July 7 open; half-size from July 1 close $200.09 held through holiday gap; (2) QQQ July 18 puts: EXIT at July 7 open per July 1 brief invalidation condition (Goldilocks NFP confirmed); (3) SPCX Nasdaq 100 effective inclusion: ~$4.3B passive arrives July 7 (Day 10 of bond distribution) — DO NOT buy the spike; (4) SK Hynix Stop Day 2 determination: July 3 KST session (KRX OPEN; US CLOSED) determines mandatory exit — monitor at 6:30 AM UTC July 3. ADDITIONAL CONTEXT: BTC at $61,324 is $676 below Gate 1 ($62,000); July 2 UTC midnight close is the first Gate 1 test in 12 sessions. Korea circuit breaker (KOSPI -4.45%; SK Hynix -10.96%; Apple/CXMT/YMTC mobile DRAM) is the dominant overnight risk through the holiday gap but does NOT break the US BUY regime.

ideas.name: NVIDIA Corporation
ideas.timeframe: 1–3 days conditional; full-size July 7; August 26 Q2 FY27 earnings
ideas.idea: Full-size add at July 7 open IF NVDA opens above $200 AND SPX >7,460 AND VIX <17 simultaneously at 9:25 AM ET. Half-size position from July 1 close ($200.09) is held through the holiday gap. Stop: $195 close-basis (unchanged). If July 7 fails all three gates: hold half-size only; next gate test is the August 26 Q2 FY27 earnings ($91B guide). Do NOT panic-sell half-size on Korea-shock follow-through if SPX/VIX gates remain intact.
ideas.why: The Apple/CXMT/YMTC mobile DRAM story (primary July 2 chip-sector catalyst) is categorically irrelevant to NVDA Blackwell: CXMT and YMTC make smartphone DRAM and NAND, not HBM4 for AI data centers. NVDA's supply chain is exclusively HBM4 from SK Hynix and Micron — neither of which has any exposure to China mobile DRAM. The July 2 selloff to $197.58 is sector-rotation from Korea-shock headlines, not fundamental deterioration. Goldilocks NFP (~119K) and intact SPX/VIX gates confirm the macro regime for full NVDA re-entry. The mandatory exit from Stop Day 2 at $193.85 (June 29 close) was a risk-management protocol; the fundamental Blackwell Ultra thesis (GB300 NVL72 = 1.5x GB200 performance, sovereign AI capex $100B+ confirmed) has not changed.
ideas.trigger: July 7 open: check at 9:25 AM ET — NVDA must open ABOVE $200 AND SPX futures must indicate >7,460 AND VIX must be pre-market <17 simultaneously. If any single criterion fails: hold half-size only, do not add. Next gate check: July 8 open (if July 7 fails) or August 26 earnings (structural re-entry).
ideas.risk: NVDA opens below $200 for a third consecutive session (July 3 pre-market or July 7 open) on Korea-shock follow-through or new Apple/China semiconductor headline over the holiday gap; SPX rolls below 7,460 on overnight risk-off; VIX spikes above 17; $195 close-basis stop triggered on July 7 session — mandatory half-size exit with no re-entry until August 26 earnings framework.

ideas.name: Invesco QQQ Trust (July 18 puts — EXIT)
ideas.idea: EXIT QQQ July 18 puts at July 7 open. The stated invalidation condition from the July 1 brief has been confirmed: NFP ~119K is Goldilocks (within 90–130K range, wages +0.2%). Per the hedge framework: 'exit puts at July 7 open; shift to net long if SPX >7,460 AND VIX <17 confirmed on July 7.' The tail risk being hedged (hot NFP >150K locking in BofA 3-hike path through 3-day holiday gap) did NOT materialize. Holding puts into a confirmed BUY regime reverses risk/reward from hedge to drag.
ideas.why: The QQQ puts were sized as a 2–3% gross hedge against the NFP binary through an unhedgeable 3-day holiday gap. That binary has resolved favorably (Goldilocks). The hedge has served its purpose. Exiting at July 7 open frees capital for the net-long activation: NVDA full-size add, MU initiation, GOOGL/META adds. Every day the puts are held past the invalidation condition is a day of time decay eating into the hedge value in a BUY regime.
ideas.trigger: July 7 open — exit QQQ July 18 puts at market order immediately at 9:30 AM ET. No conditions required. Exception: if QQQ opens down more than 3% on an unexpected overnight shock (geopolitical, emergency Fed statement), reassess whether to hold puts as renewed hedge before selling.
ideas.risk: Overnight July 3–6 shock (military escalation, emergency FOMC statement, major geopolitical event) causes QQQ to open sharply lower July 7 — in that scenario, the puts are the most valuable asset in the portfolio and selling at open would be premature.

ideas.name: SpaceX
ideas.timeframe: 2–3 weeks (through Nasdaq 100 inclusion Day 10 and clearance est. July 9–11)
ideas.idea: Step aside HIGH conviction — DO NOT BUY SPCX on July 7 Nasdaq 100 inclusion spike. Bond distribution Day 9 (July 6) and Day 10 (July 7): $4.3B passive arrives July 7. Russell 1000 June 26 template (Day 4): intraday spike fully absorbed same session. Monitor July 6 volume (Day 9, est. 20–35M) and July 7 volume (Day 10, est. 10–15M residual + $4.3B passive) for clearance signal. Re-entry gate: volume <5M shares/day for 2–3 consecutive sessions THEN two consecutive $185+ closes. Base case clearance: July 9–11.
ideas.why: Today's session was definitive: Goldilocks NFP spike to $174.95 immediately absorbed by bond distribution sellers, with SPCX closing at $157.98 (-7.54%). If Goldilocks NFP cannot break through bond distribution supply, the July 7 Nasdaq 100 inclusion ($4.3B) is the last remaining large demand catalyst before clearance. The Russell 1000 June 26 precedent (Day 4 passive absorbed intraday) is the correct model. Additionally: IG floor buffer has narrowed to $6.16 (day low $156.16 − $150 floor); a Korea-contagion-driven July 6 open below $155 would put the IG floor at acute risk — the step-aside position is cash, which cannot lose money through the holiday gap.
ideas.trigger: Volume <5M shares/day for 2–3 consecutive sessions (Days 11–13 est., July 9–11) THEN two consecutive closes above $185 on above-average volume. Earliest re-entry activation: July 9–11. DO NOT enter on July 7 spike.
ideas.risk: July 6 (Day 9) opening below $150 IG floor on Korea-contagion — framework requires two consecutive CLOSING breaches of $150 = IG floor failure + full reassessment; SPCX Nasdaq 100 inclusion fully absorbed intraday with no sustained move above $165; clearance delayed to Day 14+ (July 14+) if non-monotonic volume persists.

ideas.name: Bitcoin
ideas.timeframe: Post-July 3 UTC midnight (Gate 1 test); re-entry July 7 earliest if two-gate sequence confirmed
ideas.idea: BTC at $61,324 (pre-session July 2) is $676 below Gate 1 ($62,000). Monitor: (1) July 2 UTC midnight close — above $62,000 = Gate 1 confirmed; (2) July 3 UTC midnight close — above $62,000 for second consecutive night = Gate 2 confirmed; (3) IBIT daily net inflow confirmation (T+2 reporting lag — check Bloomberg ETF data). IF all three confirmed by July 6 AM: re-entry activated for July 7 open. Size: 20–25% of crypto allocation at July 7 open. EVEN WITH BOTH GATES CONFIRMED: do not re-enter without at least one confirmed positive IBIT flow day.
ideas.why: Goldilocks NFP (~119K) and US BUY regime upgrade are the most constructive macro catalysts for BTC since the halving in April 2024. BTC is already up +4.6% from the July 1 close ($58,662 → $61,324) and $676 from Gate 1 — this is the closest approach to the re-entry framework in 12 sessions. A post-holiday risk-on environment (SPX/VIX gates intact, Goldilocks confirmed) structurally supports the post-halving bull cycle thesis. However: IBIT accumulated $4.5B in June outflows with no confirmed positive inflow day in 12+ sessions — institutional demand must re-engage before tactical re-entry. The two-gate sequence is the minimum filter for genuine demand vs. holiday-thin momentum.
ideas.trigger: TWO consecutive UTC midnight closes above $62,000 AND at least one confirmed positive IBIT daily net inflow. Check: (1) July 2 UTC midnight BTC price via Crypto.com; (2) July 3 UTC midnight BTC price; (3) IBIT flows via Bloomberg ETF data (T+2 lag). Earliest confirmed re-entry: July 7 open. If only Gate 1 confirmed by July 6 AM (not Gate 2): watch-only, do not enter.
ideas.risk: BTC gives back the Goldilocks rally overnight July 2–3 and closes UTC below $62,000 — Gate 1 not confirmed; framework reset to watch. Korea-shock contagion spreads to crypto over holiday weekend (crypto markets never close — risk 24/7). IBIT outflows continue through July 7 despite Goldilocks NFP — no institutional demand signal; tactical entry without IBIT confirmation = premature.

ideas.name: Alphabet Inc.
ideas.idea: GOOGL position from July 2 open entry is held (Day 4 of Dow rebalancing + Goldilocks NFP). Add more at July 7 open on any dip to $350–$355. The Dow rebalancing systematic demand from 44+ Dow-tracking ETFs continues for 2–4 more sessions post-inclusion. Korea shock has zero direct impact on GOOGL — Google Cloud AI infrastructure and Search monetization are domestic US revenue stories. Q2 2026 earnings (late July) is the next fundamental catalyst: first full quarter reflecting Dow inclusion flows and AI Search monetization.
ideas.why: GOOGL's Dow inclusion (+5% on June 29 first Dow day) creates persistent price-weighting rebalancing demand (~7x Verizon's prior weighting). Goldilocks NFP confirms US businesses remain active and expanding — directly constructive for ad spend. ISM 54.0 (July 1) accelerated the Google Cloud AI infrastructure narrative. SCOTUS Fed independence ruling (June 29) removed the primary regulatory overhang. Q2 earnings setup: AI Mode Search monetization is the first quarter at scale, and Google Cloud is the #3 cloud AI platform benefiting from enterprise AI capex cycle confirmed by Samsung $226B data center commitment.
ideas.trigger: July 7 open — add GOOGL on any dip to $350–$355. Stop: $339 (below June 30 low). Target: $380–$390 pre-Q2 earnings (late July).
ideas.risk: DOJ antitrust search remedies (user choice screen mandates) materially reduce Search revenue before Q2 earnings; AI Search AI Mode cannibalizes ad clicks faster than AI ad placements compensate; tech-sector Korea-shock follow-through on July 7 drags GOOGL below $340 before Q2 earnings confirmation.

ideas.name: Meta Platforms
ideas.idea: META position from July 2 open entry is held. AI ad targeting improvements compound in real-time across 3.3B daily active users with zero semiconductor supply chain exposure to the Korea shock. Goldilocks NFP confirms US consumers remain employed and spending — directly constructive for META's ad revenue model. Add on any July 7 weakness. Q2 2026 earnings (late July) is the first full quarter of AI monetization at scale: setup for 'beat and raise.'
ideas.why: META's revenue model has the tightest AI-to-revenue conversion of any big tech name: every AI improvement in ad targeting reaches 3.3B users immediately, with no enterprise sales cycle, no semiconductor sourcing risk, and no regulatory AI Act enforcement lag. Goldilocks NFP + intact US BUY regime = sustained consumer ad spend environment for the next 4–8 weeks through Q2 earnings. FCF $60B+ annually makes META the most rate-resistant large-cap AI name in a Warsh hawkish hold environment.
ideas.trigger: July 7 — add META on any weakness. Stop: prior week low. Target: new ATH before Q2 earnings.
ideas.risk: EU AI Act discriminatory compliance burden ($2–3B one-time); Apple iOS ATT 3.0 (hypothetical) further restricts cross-app targeting; Q2 earnings miss on ad revenue slowdown signaling broader consumer employment weakness; SPX breaks below 7,300.

ideas.name: Micron Technology
ideas.idea: Buy MU on any dip to $1,150–$1,200 at July 7 open. The Apple/CXMT/YMTC mobile DRAM story is a MICRON POSITIVE: Apple diversifying China-market DRAM to CXMT (Chinese mobile DRAM) means Samsung and SK Hynix lose mobile DRAM share — but Micron's primary revenue is HBM4 (AI data centers) and US enterprise DRAM, not mobile. Korea-shock sector rotation may create a buying opportunity in MU if it gaps down sympathetically on July 7 open. Size 25–40% of AI semi allocation below $1,200.
ideas.why: The Apple/CXMT diversification confirms that US DoD-mandated US-manufactured HBM (Micron's Idaho fab) becomes MORE strategic, not less. CXMT and YMTC are on the Pentagon 1260H blacklist — US government AI procurement mandates specifically exclude them. Every mobile DRAM share that CXMT gains from Samsung/SK Hynix in China is a mobile DRAM share that DOESN'T compete against Micron's HBM4 and enterprise DRAM pricing. Plus: $50B Q4 FY26 guide (+40% above prior consensus) is already confirmed; HBM4 sold out through 2026; no forced-exit overhang unlike NVDA; no ADR mechanics unlike SK Hynix.
ideas.trigger: July 7 open — buy MU at or below $1,200 (any NFP/Korea sympathetic dip). If MU opens above $1,200 and no dip materializes: wait for natural pullback to $1,150–$1,200 within 1–2 weeks. Stop: $1,100. Target: $1,350–$1,400 through September Q4 FY26 earnings.
ideas.risk: HBM demand cycle peaks earlier than H1 2027 as AI model efficiency improvements reduce memory per compute unit; Samsung or SK Hynix restore NVIDIA HBM3E certification earlier than expected; Korea contagion extends to US DRAM sector on Apple/CXMT headline misread; MU Q4 FY26 guide miss at September earnings (most likely invalidation).

ideas.name: SK Hynix
ideas.timeframe: 2–3 days (July 3 KST close determines Stop Day 2; exit decision by July 6 KST open)
ideas.idea: STOP DAY 1 CONFIRMED — monitor July 3 KST close (6:30 AM UTC Thursday July 3; KRX OPEN; US CLOSED for observed July 4). KST close ₩2,301,000 (-10.96%) is ₩239,000 below ₩2,540,000 mandatory stop — Stop Day 1. TWO consecutive KST closes below ₩2,540,000 = mandatory full exit. IF July 3 KST closes below ₩2,540,000: STOP DAY 2 = mandatory full exit at July 6 KST open (no discretion). IF July 3 KST closes above ₩2,540,000: Stop Day 1 isolated; framework continues; reassess July 7. DO NOT average down at any price. If mandatory exit triggers: re-entry framework requires SKHY ADR listing stability (July 10) + KOSPI re-clearing 8,500 + SK Hynix re-clearing ₩2,700,000.
ideas.why: The Apple/CXMT/YMTC mobile DRAM story drove KOSPI -4.45% and a circuit breaker session — the first double-digit down session for SK Hynix this year. Stop Day 1 has never been triggered before today. However: the structural HBM4 thesis (NVDA Blackwell exclusive supplier, $29.4B ADR listing July 10) is unaffected — Apple's CXMT negotiation is mobile DRAM (smartphones), not HBM4 (AI data centers). The ADR underwriter floor at ₩2,258,000 (July 2 session low) confirms the $29.4B underwriter backstop is still present. Goldilocks NFP processed overnight by Asian markets is the primary catalyst for a July 3 KST recovery above ₩2,540,000. The two-consecutive-close protocol exists precisely for this scenario — one bad day should not override the ADR listing structural event 6 sessions away.
ideas.trigger: July 3 KST close (check at 6:30 AM UTC): ABOVE ₩2,540,000 = Stop Day 1 isolated; BELOW ₩2,540,000 = STOP DAY 2 = mandatory full exit at July 6 KST open (first KRX session of the week, Monday Korea time = 6:30 AM UTC July 6). Execute at market open with no exceptions.
ideas.risk: Stop Day 2 triggers July 3 KST: mandatory exit on July 6 KST open means exiting 4 KRX sessions before the July 10 ADR listing catalyst (SKHY); Korea CPI 3.2% and KOSPI circuit breaker psychology may keep domestic Korean sellers active on July 3 KST regardless of Goldilocks US NFP; ADR underwriter floor drift (₩2,541,000 June 30 → ₩2,502,000 July 1 → ₩2,258,000 July 2) may continue to July 3, making a close above ₩2,540,000 structurally difficult.
